messages:
allegra: Quick summary from the caligo-compact-v1 onboarding run (int6 experiment). Short-query devset recall@10 fell 0.72 -> 0.66 after per-tensor symmetric int6 with 1k calib.

sam: Oof. Did you use per-tensor per-layer or global scale?

allegra: Per-tensor per-layer symmetric. Calib sample pool was random short queries (1k).

morgan: Any distributional numbers? cosine shifts, norm changes?

allegra: Median cosine delta -0.018. 5th percentile delta -0.043. Mean embedding norm dropped ~1.2%. Silhouette (topic subset) 0.35 -> 0.28.

jess: That suggests local neighbor reordering. How about recall@100?

allegra: recall@100: fp16 0.88 -> int6 0.85. So mostly local shuffles.

kai: Try per-channel quant for weights and keep final norm in fp16 (hybrid). Also bump calib to 5k and use clip-aware range estimation.

allegra: Agreed. I'll run three variants: (A) per-channel int6, 5k calib; (B) per-channel + final-norm fp16 hybrid; (C) per-tensor but 10k calib + clip-aware.

sam: Add median-rank-change and percent of queries with rank delta > 5 as metrics. Those helped us triage earlier.

morgan: Pushed a quick TSNE of the run artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/runs/1767770000/tsne. You can see two small topical islands merge under int6.

jess: Also include a small paraphrase-heavy set (typos, punctuation changes, code-like tokens). Quant tends to harm rare-token geometry.

allegra: Will attach a paraphrase subset (n=250) to all runs. Will also compute per-lang recall breakdown for the multilingual holdout.

kai: For rollout planning, if recall@100 is stable and only recall@10 moves, we could route int6 for low-cost endpoints with a 5% fp16 sample for regression alerting. But need downstream rerank check.

allegra: Good point. I'll run an A/B with our staging reranker and report MRR and P@1.

sam: When you post results include: seed, calib pool id, quant toolchain & commit, and exact eval command.

allegra: Eval command used for baseline (included in run metadata):

```
./eval/run_sim_eval.sh --model caligo-compact-v1 --quant int6 --quant-scheme per-tensor --calib-samples 1000 --batch 256 --dataset shortquery-dev --k 1,5,10,100
```

ci-bot: Queued run 68912 for variants A,B,C. Est ETA ~22m. Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/68912

morgan: If A/B MRR drop < 0.01 and recall@100 holds, we can consider a canary in staging for non-critical routes. Also prepare an automatic fallback policy keyed on median-rank-change > 3.

jess: Remind QA to include paraphrase+code tokens and a tiny set of edge-case long queries; quantization sometimes warps long-sequence geometry.

allegra: Done. Starting runs now. I'll post the per-variant table (recall@1/5/10/100, median-rank-change, silhouette, rerank-MRR) back here when finished. End.
